notes.key_messages:
To maximise their chances of success on this paper, candidates should:
• select carefully only the information from the text that answers the question
• be aware that the questions follow the order of the texts
• ensure that grammar mistakes do not impede communication of the message.
notes.general_comments:
Candidates appeared to have sufficient time to complete the paper, and almost all candidates were
appropriately entered for the examination. There were very few instances of candidates leaving questions
blank. At times, grammatical accuracy hindered comprehension of the candidate’s answer.
